title: Продюсер уже в зале  (The Producer Is Here)

segments.t: Just as the food stylist finishes coating the lamb with varnish and glue for the camera, Dmitry Nagiyev walks into the dining room with his VIP producer because his shoot was canceled early. Let's listen to the Russian scene first.
Дмитрий Владимирович, вы же сегодня на съёмках?
Иди скажи ему, что продюсер уже здесь.
Сказал, что продюсер на месте, можешь подавать блюда.
Now let's go back through their exchange line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.

'Thank goodness, it was canceled.' In spoken Russian, Dmitry omits unnecessary linking verbs so the key idea lands immediately.
'Is Vitya in his kitchen?' Dmitry uses natural conversational word order here to highlight the most important part of the reply.
'Yes, he was there.' The past-tense verb ending marks the grammatical gender and number of the subject directly.

'Dmitry Vladimirovich has just arrived.' Vika uses natural conversational word order here to highlight the most important part of the reply.

'He said the producer is at his table and you can serve the dishes.' Vika uses natural conversational word order here to highlight the most important part of the reply. Now let's hear the entire conversation once more from start to finish.
